content:
Apple TV is set to launch a brand-new original comedy series called "Brothers," starring Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson, arriving next month. Here is the trailer.

"Brothers," the comedy series, will premiere on September 23, created by Lee Eisenberg from "The Office."

Apple TV is currently airing Season 4 of "Ted Lasso," but another highly anticipated comedy is also about to debut.

The "Brothers" series starring Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson is a brand-new original show on Apple TV, with the two playing fictionalized versions of themselves.

"Brothers" will premiere on Wednesday, September 23, with the first two episodes dropping at once, followed by weekly releases until November 4.

The mastermind behind the show is Lee Eisenberg, who was a key member of the creative team behind the hit sitcom "The Office," serving as a writer and producer from Seasons 2 through 6.

Below is the synopsis provided by Apple for "Brothers," followed by the trailer:

Also arriving on Apple TV in September, in addition to "Brothers," are a new season of "Slow Horses," the original crime thriller "Last Seen," as well as the film "Mayday" starring Ryan Reynolds.

What do you think of the "Brothers" trailer? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, or it can be subscribed to at a discounted rate through an Apple One bundle.
